campaign: r16 three cuts on the r12.6 TP champion base
base_gate: W6B_NATIVE_SEED=0 — the r13.7 native-seed terminal overwrite is gated OFF for the campaign (preserved verbatim in code; right discontinuity 519.7 mm is committed structural)
base_run: reproduced the r12.6 champion bit-identically: g1 15.891/1.607 mm, g2 5/14, g3 246/272, g4 1.377/2.536 rad, g5reg 1.06/0.98 mm, frame_alignment True

cut1_holdable_band_clamp_ur5e_seed.spec: r8 holdable-band clamp ported to the UR5E curl channel (seed-band membership from the UR5E terminal seed)
cut1_holdable_band_clamp_ur5e_seed.verdict: REVERT — regresses its own target gate
cut1_holdable_band_clamp_ur5e_seed.mechanism: the UR5E-seed clampable set is wider (11 vs 7 joints/side: adds ffj1/2, thj1/2); the raised band floors push swing commands into the contact-crush zone
cut1_holdable_band_clamp_ur5e_seed.finding: the r8 premise (command-edge wind-up) does not hold in the UR5e regime — realised violations are contact-crush of 1.0-2.5 rad (per-joint diagnostic added to the gate4 record: right ffj0 1.19 / rfj0 1.38; left thj1 2.54 / thj3 1.07 / ffj0 1.01)
cut1_holdable_band_clamp_ur5e_seed.disposition: code kept behind W6B_R16_CLAMP_UR5E=1, default off

cut2_manipulability_gated_swing_pose.spec: swing pose leg gated by manipulability (singular regions yield to the position leg) + elbow-up comfort
cut2_manipulability_gated_swing_pose.verdict: NO-GO — Pareto trade at every threshold
cut2_manipulability_gated_swing_pose.scope_correction: Main scoped cut 2 to the swing; a first probe that also gated the terminal pose leg broke gate1 right 15.9 -> 213.3 mm (the right terminal region IS the low-m zone)
cut2_manipulability_gated_swing_pose.finding: the registered path's median Yoshikawa index is 0.02 — the whole swing is low-manipulability, so the comfort leg is load-bearing for the r12.6 branch family; gating it trades gate3/g4 against gate1/g5. Consistent with r14: the support contact is command-path-inherent
cut2_manipulability_gated_swing_pose.disposition: code kept behind W6B_R16_MANIP_GATE=1, default off

cut3_left_terminal_wrist_trim.spec: left wrist j4-j6 +-30 deg scan at the terminal window against the pad-landing band; solved offsets become the left terminal orientation target (raw/registered dual report)
cut3_left_terminal_wrist_trim.verdict: INFEASIBLE AS SPECIFIED — the burial is positional, not wrist-rotational

results.distance_objective_unburial_ignored: j5 +10/j6 +20 deg: best pad 0.66 mm (and 0.041 mm at the 5 deg grid) but a DIFFERENT pad is buried — gate1 requires NO buried pad
results.gate1_faithful_objective: with burial counted, the best feasible config in the whole j4-j6 +-30 deg domain lands 48.2 mm off the rectangle (unburied, fwd 33.8 deg passes) — 3 of 4 pads sit THROUGH the face plane at the verified grasp pose; un-burying them by wrist rotation necessarily leaves the rectangle

cut3_left_terminal_wrist_trim.identified_fix: the burial depth is ~1.6 mm along the face normal — a small LEFT TERMINAL TARGET RETRACTION (~2-5 mm along the face inward normal before the r12.9 6D solve) is the positional fix; outside the j4-j6 wrist-rotation spec, needs Main's ruling
cut3_left_terminal_wrist_trim.disposition: code kept behind W6B_R16_WRIST_TRIM=1, default off

shipped_state: the r12.6 TP champion, unchanged (all three cuts default-off); floors held: g5reg 1.06/0.98 mm, frame_alignment True

final_table.gate1_left_caveat: the left 1.607 mm is burial-infeasible (pad centre 1.6 mm through the plane; pad_center_buried=True) — it was never a gate1 pass; the honest left terminal gap is the burial, which cut 3 proved wrist-rotation-infeasible
